display.title: Rosh Chodesh: The Head of the Month (Erev Rosh Chodesh Av)
display.summary_short: Why the first day of the month is called the 'head' of the month: its blessings flow to every day that follows, so we pray and behave our best on Rosh Chodesh.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given on Erev Rosh Chodesh Av. Uncle Yossi explains that Rosh Chodesh means 'head of the month', not 'new month'. Just as the head directs the whole body and gives it life, the first day of the month is linked to every other day: on Rosh Chodesh Hashem grants the blessings of health, life and sustenance, including food, clothing and shelter, which are then shared out over the month. That is why there are special prayers on Rosh Chodesh and our conduct matters so much. Some visit the resting places of tzaddikim on Erev Rosh Chodesh to pray for a good month. He recalls the Shabbos Mevarchim prayer for a month of life, peace, joy and redemption, and asks that Av bring Moshiach.
display.lesson: Rosh Chodesh is the head of the month; how we pray and act on it brings blessing to the whole month.
